edits.text: PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff's First Requests for Production subject to the general objections and the request-specific responses and objections set forth below. These responses are made without waiver of, and expressly preserve, all applicable objections, privileges, protections, and rights. Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged documents within its possession, custody, or control as stated in the specific responses, following a reasonable and proportional search.
edits.name: Revise Preliminary Statement

edits.text: 1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to the Requests to the extent they seek information or documents protected by the attorney-client privilege, work-product doctrine, common-interest doctrine, or any other applicable privilege or protection; seek documents not within Defendant's possession, custody, or control; are overbroad, unduly burdensome, disproportionate to the needs of the case, or not relevant to any party's claim or defense; or seek confidential, proprietary, or private information without appropriate protections. Defendant will not rely on these General Objections to withhold responsive, non-privileged documents unless a specific response states that documents are being withheld on that basis.
edits.name: Clarify General Objections

edits.text: 2. PRODUCTION AND ROLLING SCHEDULE. Subject to and without waiving the foregoing objections and the request-specific objections, Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged documents within its possession, custody, or control after a reasonable and proportional search. Defendant will make production on a rolling basis as follows: (a) an initial production of readily available responsive documents within 14 days; (b) a second rolling production within 30 days; and (c) a substantial completion production within 45 days, absent good cause or further agreement of the parties. Defendant will promptly advise Plaintiff if additional time is required for any discrete source, custodian, or category of materials. The parties will meet and confer regarding ESI format, including metadata fields, load files, confidentiality designations, and treatment of any non-standard or inaccessible sources.
edits.name: Concrete Production Schedule

edits.text: 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. To the extent Defendant withholds responsive documents on the basis of privilege or protection, Defendant will identify such documents on a privilege log consistent with the applicable rules and any agreement or order governing privilege logs in this action. Defendant will provide the privilege log within a reasonable time after substantial completion of production, subject to any agreement regarding categorical logs, email threading, redactions, or other efficiency measures.
edits.name: Privilege Log Timing

edits.text: 4. RESERVATION. Defendant reserves the right to amend or supplement these responses and objections as appropriate, including based on additional investigation, discovery, court order, or agreement of the parties. Defendant will supplement these responses if it learns that a response is materially incomplete or incorrect in accordance with applicable rules.
edits.name: Reservation and Supplementation
